events.event_name: Mary Kay ‘Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared’ Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day Mary Kay beauty activation at Gansevoort Plaza with an oversized vanity installation, beauty touch-ups, interactive/photo moments and product giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay advertises 10,000 free makeup and skincare products; event listings also advertise beauty touch-ups. Giveaways are subject to supply.
events.caveats: The current Eventbrite listing is organized by Mary Kay U.S. and confirms September 15, 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Independent current listings describe the activation as free/open to the public and direct visitors to RSVP free. Treat the Eventbrite registration as the actionable admission path rather than assuming an unregistered walk-in is equivalent.
events.practical_notes: Register through the Mary Kay Eventbrite before traveling. Free product inventory is finite and may run out before the event ends.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded eos and NYLON truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Dewy Lip Shine product sampling and sweet treats are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC event listings independently agree on September 15, 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway and explicitly describe the truck as open to the public. No registration requirement was published in the sources verified in this pass. Samples/treats are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Walk up to the truck at 575 Broadway. Arrive earlier for the best chance at samples and treats.

events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Hempz Serene Waters pop-up outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square with a calm-down/body-care experience, beverage truck and event-day surprises.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free magnesium iced teas and giveaways/freebies while supplies last. A separate Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet has its own limited Eventbrite registration and purchase-related gifts.
events.caveats: Current listings agree on September 15, 12:30–6:30 PM at Ulta Beauty Herald Square and describe the general pop-up as open to the public. Do not conflate that with the separate 4–6:30 PM Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet, which requires Eventbrite confirmation and has an 80-ticket capacity; some meet-and-greet gifts are tied to purchase.
events.practical_notes: The general outdoor/pop-up experience is walk-in. If specifically attending the Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet, use its separate Eventbrite registration and follow its purchase/capacity terms.
